Summary Collaboration Themes: The collaboration between David S. Ebert and Xiangming Xiao centers on the convergence of high-resolution geospatial ecology and advanced data-driven public health surveillance. By fusing Xiao's expertise in remote sensing, wildlife ecology, and process-based environmental modeling with Ebert's strengths in breathomics, interpretable AI, and multi-source epidemiological data integration, they can develop a next-generation One Health surveillance system. This partnership leverages satellite-derived environmental data to contextualize and predict zoonotic disease spillover, particularly avian influenza, while using molecular diagnostics and AI to validate and refine ecological risk models. The joint work aims to transition from reactive disease response to predictive, spatially explicit pandemic preparedness by bridging the gap between environmental science and clinical public health informatics.
